---
# The old client-side player page. Player pages moved to /baseball/players/<slug>-<id>/ (PLAN-seo S2);
# this sends /baseball/player.html?id=<id> (and its view state) there. noindex, so it stays out of the sitemap.
title: "Player"
pagetitle: "Player profile: moved"
description: "Player profiles moved to their own pages under /baseball/players/. This address forwards each old link to the player's new page."
no-chart-libs: true
include-in-header:
  - text: '<meta name="robots" content="noindex">'
---

```{=html}
<div id="root"><p>Opening the player's page…</p></div>
<script>
(async () => {
  const q = new URLSearchParams(location.search), id = q.get("id");
  q.delete("id");
  let paths = null;
  try { paths = (await (await fetch("/data/baseball/player_urls.json")).json())[id]; } catch (e) { paths = null; }
  if (paths) { location.replace(`/baseball/players/${paths[paths.length - 1]}/${q.size ? "?" + q : ""}${location.hash}`); return; }
  document.getElementById("root").innerHTML = 'No profile for that player. Try the <a href="/baseball/players/">list of player profiles</a>, the <a href="/baseball/tools/triple-a.html">Triple-A explorer</a>, or the <a href="/baseball/tools/stuff-leaderboard.html">pitch-grade leaderboard</a>.';
})();
</script>
```
